name: glk_rust_write_path
description: EstateCoordinator write-path conformance vectors: add_kg_fact, withdraw_kg_fact, add_diary_entry, diary_entries. Parity surface: VerbSurface.swift (captureKGFact, retireKGFact) and DreamingWrites.swift (addDiaryEntry, readDiaryEntries).

cases.description: add_kg_fact stores the fact with adjective_bitmap = 0 (State::Active). The row appears in recall_kg_facts (g_state_cluster 0 < 7).
withdraw_kg_fact sets adjective_bitmap bits 0-5 to State::Withdrawn (raw 18). g_state_cluster becomes 18 >= 7, so the fact is excluded from recall_kg_facts active filter.
withdraw_kg_fact masks only bits 0-5. Upper bits (sensitivity, exportability, trust, flags) are preserved unchanged. Formula: new_bitmap = (old_bitmap & !0x3F) | 18.
add_diary_entry sets wing = 'wing_<agent_name>' and room = 'diary'. Mirrors the Swift DreamingWrites / DrawerStore wing-per-agent convention.
When embedding_model_id is empty, add_diary_entry substitutes 'no-embedding'. Mirrors Swift DreamingWrites.addDiaryEntry guard: autonomous diary writes carry no embedding.
diary_entries returns at most last_n entries, newest first. Multiple entries for the same agent are capped by last_n.
cases.precondition: 5 entries added for agent 'skippy' at filed_at 1700000000..1700000004

cases.description: diary_entries filters by agent_name. Entries from other agents do not appear in the result.
